text:
Mia Chen: Heads-up — planning to onboard sandstone-4b-compact into model catalog tomorrow 2026-03-19 10:00 PT. Need an owner for the deploy + smoke checks and someone to confirm pinning strategy.

Derek: I can own the deploy. I'll do the canary rollout and watch the first 200 reqs. ETA ok for 10:00 PT :+1:

Sanjay Gupta: I'll take smoke checks and quick evals. I'll run the standard perf/quality script and post results in this thread. Expected ~15 mins.

Mia Chen: Thanks both. Can Derek also ping dev review — I left a tiny CR on the catalog ingest PR (link: https://git.redwood/ri/model-catalog/pulls/482). Need approval before deploy.

Derek: Seen, replying now. If CI green I'll merge by 09:45 PT.

Devlina: Adding checklist — please confirm each before deploy:
- model artifact checksum verified
- quantization profile attached
- serving config: batch_size=8, seq_len=2048
- canary_pct=5 -> 25 -> 100

ops-bot: scheduled maintenance window reserved: 2026-03-19 09:50-11:30 PT

Mia Chen: Rollback plan: immediate alias swap back to current pinned variant (stable-v12). Derek, can you keep the rollback command handy?

Derek: Yup. Rollback command pasted below for quick copy:
```
rwdctl catalog alias swap --model sandstone-4b-compact --from=canary-v1 --to=stable-v12
rwdctl cluster scale --name=canary-sandstone --replicas=0
```

Sanjay Gupta: Smoke checklist I'll run (and report pass/fail):
1) 50 short chat prompts (<32 tokens) correctness sample
2) 100 long-context (>=1024 tokens) perf tokens
3) 100 concurrent embedding calls (for indexing) latency sample
4) monitor error-rate and token cost

Devlina: DevX note — docs updated with sample prompt templates and function specs. URL: https://redwood.internal/docs/catalog/sandstone-4b-compact

ConsoleBot: Canary deploy started by Derek at 10:02 PT, canary_pct=5

Sanjay Gupta: First smoke run started 10:05 PT. Running 1/4 tests.

Mia Chen: Monitoring metrics to watch: p50 latency, p95, token cost/unit, 5xx rate, KV cache hit rate. Please flag anything >20% regress vs baseline.

Sanjay Gupta: Perf pass for long-contexts, p95 increased 8% vs baseline — within tolerance. Posting logs.

Derek: Canary advanced to 25% at 10:20 PT. No errors observed. Merging PR now.

Devlina: Reminder — pinning strategy: once canary at 100% and stability verified, create a catalog pin entry:
```
POST /catalog/pins
{ "model": "sandstone-4b-compact", "version": "v1.0", "reason": "onboard - baseline stable" }
```

Mia Chen: If everything looks good after 30 mins at 100% we'll pin and close the rollout. If rollback needed call out in this thread and Derek will run alias swap.

Sanjay Gupta: Final: roll to 100% completed 10:42 PT. All smoke tests green. p95 ~ +7%, 5xx=0. Pinning now.

Derek: Ran pin command and added note in CHANGELOG. :tada:

Mia Chen: Great work — thanks team. I'll follow up with the release note and update the model matrix.

Devlina: Posted docs/observability dashboard links in #product as well. :sparkles:

ops-bot: deploy finished 10:47 PT — canary->stable complete.

Mia Chen: Thread archived; keeping for audit. If anyone spots regressions please reopen.
